audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Vladimir the first five stages and the page called this a favoured 4/10 lane, while the data records a 44.79% win rate — the packet itself flags 'level chart contradicts data'.
audit.why: Nasus does not lose stages to poke; he answers every harass by last-hitting for a Siphoning Strike stack, and from level 6 Fury of the Sands hands him health, armour, MR and percent-health damage. The mirror audit (nasus__vladimir) reached the same conclusion and listed the rows it could not flip — it believed the enum tokens would fail the length band. They are exempt (ENUM_FIELD, apply-proposals.js:78), so the flips are proposed here as one atomic paired group.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Skill / Nasus / Skill / Nasus / Nasus / Nasus in phases[N].side and win[N] together, with diff, diffRating, tone, breakdown.difficulty, report[2].t and report[14].t brought in line.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6, first item and two items were all written as Vladimir spikes.
audit.why: Fury of the Sands is Nasus's defining spike: it grants Health, Attack Range, bonus Armor and Magic Resistance and a reduced Siphoning Strike cooldown, and it damages nearby enemies as a percentage of their health — so stacking HP through Crimson Pact is exactly the wrong answer against it. Vladimir's real spike window is levels 3-5 poke and denial, before the ult exists.
audit.corrected: whys[4], whys[5], whys[6], phases[4].why and phases[5].why rewritten to name the spike that actually lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1].d sat under the title 'Fight inside his W slow' but carried a generic 'burning it for tiny value' body from another matchup's template.
audit.why: Wither is a 700-range, 15s-at-rank-1 decay that cuts both Move Speed and Attack Speed over time — against a champion with no dash and only a 28s Sanguine Pool it removes the disengage entirely. Siphoning Strike is also an auto-attack reset at 255 range, so the wind-up is the cue to step back, not the cast.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d now states what Wither does and what to do about it.

audit.why: Wither at 15s rank 1 is correctly identified as the tracked cooldown throughout.
